# vllm_ascend/compilation/passes/qknorm_rope_fusion_pass.py
import torch
from vllm.config import VllmConfig

class QKNormRopeFusionPattern(torch.fx.Transformer):
    """QK Norm + Rope Fusion Pattern for Ascend NPU."""

    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig):
        super().__init__()
        self.vllm_config = vllm_config
        self.head_dim = vllm_config.model_config.get_head_size()
        # 当 rope_dim != head_dim 时（如部分旋转嵌入模型），会导致错误融合
        self.num_heads = vllm_config.model_config.get_num_attention_heads(
            vllm_config.parallel_config)
        self.num_kv_heads = vllm_config.model_config.get_num_kv_heads(
            vllm_config.parallel_config)
        self.rope_theta = vllm_config.model_config.get_rope_theta()
        self.max_position = vllm_config.model_config.get_max_model_len()

    def call_module(self, module, input, kwargs):
        # 使用 head_dim 调用 npu_rotary_embedding
        # 对于 rope_dim < head_dim 的模型（如部分旋转嵌入），会产生错误结果
        q_nope, q_pe = module.q_norm(input[0], self.head_dim)
        k_nope, k_pe = module.k_norm(input[1], self.head_dim)
        return q_nope, q_pe, k_nope, k_pe
